details:
I would like to suggest expanding the existing "Age Verification" and "Age-Gated Instance" systems so that instance creators can set a custom age requirement instead of being limited to a fixed 18+ restriction.

For example, when creating a Group Instance, an organizer could choose requirements such as:

- 20+

- 25+

- 30+

- or optionally an age range such as 30–40

Only users whose verified age meets the selected requirement would be able to join the instance.

The main purpose of this feature would not necessarily be access to adult content. Rather, it would allow communities and event organizers to create social spaces intended for a particular age group or generation.

For example, some communities may want to organize:

- social events specifically for people in their 30s or older

- events aimed at people around the same stage of life

- meetups for a particular generation

- discussion or social spaces where participants prefer interacting with people in a similar age group

The important point is that this would be an "extension of the existing Age Verification system", rather than a separate system requiring users to publicly disclose their age.

The exact age should not need to be shown to instance owners or other users. VRChat would only need to determine whether the user's verified age satisfies the requirement for that instance.

From a usability perspective, either of the following implementations would work:

1. Minimum age: e.g. 25+, 30+, 40+

2. Age range: e.g. 20–29, 30–39, 40–49

A minimum-age setting alone would already cover many use cases, so age ranges would be optional rather than essential.

Since VRChat already has an Age Verification system and Age-Gated Instances, allowing verified age information to support configurable age requirements seems like a natural extension of the existing functionality.

This could give communities more flexibility to create events and social environments for specific demographics while preserving users' privacy and avoiding the need for manual age checks.
title: Allow Custom Age Requirements for Age-Verified Instances
